ratings.comment: She's a great teacher, who encourages student participation and uses lots of examples in class so you really understand the material. Definitely take her over Tierny (who uses overheads and just lectures almost all the time)...trust me.

Anita is a great professor.  She keeps the class interesting with jokes and real world references. 301 is basically an expansion of 100 so it's not that hard of a class to begin with, but I would definitely take this class with her.
Very helpful, and will make sure everyone understands what she is going over. Take her if you can, you won't regret it! (Also very attractive)

I had Anita for AIS 301 and 302 and she did a very good job of explaining the material and making sure that everyone was following along in both classes. Tests and quizzes fairly covered the material. I've heard a lot of people complain about these classes but they all had different professors. Take them with her if you can!

I love Anita!  I had her for 301 and 302.  302 is difficult, but she makes sure that everyone understands and will explain it in as many ways as she can until you understand.  Her exams are tough but definitely fair.  She is super knowledgeable and always has an answer to your questions.  I would definitely recommend her, especially over Cheng.
Very clear lectures, tests were generally fair. If you understand the material well and do the homework/practice exams you should be fine.
